# Zoho

> > Zoho is a comprehensive suite of cloud-based business software applications, including CRM, workplace collaboration tools, and AI-powered solutions like Zia.

Founded by Sridhar Vembu, Zoho offers integrated business applications with a focus on privacy, data protection, and low-code development. The platform features AI capabilities through Zia, supports custom integrations via Deluge and Catalyst, and serves businesses globally with localized solutions across Europe, Asia-Pacific, and Latin America.

## Key Topics

- Zoho CRM
- Zia (AI Assistant)
- Deluge scripting
- Catalyst low-code platform
- Privacy and GDPR compliance
- Business integrations
- Workplace collaboration
- Custom AI skills
- AutoML
- Data protection
- Remote work solutions
- Digital transformation
- Chart and data visualization
- WhatsApp Business integration
- Developer tools
